# criteria: c1 design vs C41-020 (spire-height/disc-width ref ~0.55, my tolerance +/-25% = 0.41-0.69); c2 disc width ratio new/old saucer (pass 0.90-1.15) + ink tone (ink L / skin L) and stroke width (2x median, 2x p90 of distance-transform ridge) vs neck blaster; c3 max |diff| outside the chest change region (bbox+10px) vs base; c4 cheek words/blaster vs base.

# Method: per-pixel max-channel diff old vs new; chest change region = largest blob of diff>12; ink = pixels <0.6x local skin luminance, isolated by diff; disc width = widest rim extent over rotation -20..+20 deg, verified on overlays (shirt folds excluded); blaster ink sampled in the neck box with shadow fill removed. Measurements are approximate (+/-2 px).
